title: McConnell invites Kirkpatrick to Senate interviews and the Fugal briefing
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee hearing room

tellings.quote: I invited him with some regularity to sit in on our interviews of uh of Navy pilots and and some of the scientific figures.

plain: A Senate staffer on the Armed Services Committee named Kurt McConnell says that between about 2017 and 2022 he regularly invited a Pentagon official named Sean Kirkpatrick to sit in on Senate interviews with Navy pilots and scientists about UFO sightings, and to a briefing from a businessman named Brandon Fugal. McConnell tells Michels this as the one who sent the invitations, which would mean Kirkpatrick heard this testimony firsthand.
